steps.text: NA-0754 (R379): THE RELAY PANE CANNOT LIE OR LOSE. Drives the arms of Y1/Y4/Y5/Y6 that a scenario can genuinely reach. CLAIM BOUNDARY, stated up front: no relay is reachable from this harness - no fixture relay exists in this repo and building one is the successor harness-maintenance lane (ENG-0226). So the GREEN half of the model (Y2, Y3's live half) is NOT driven here; it is the operator's acceptance flight, recorded [O] in the evidence doc. What IS driven here is the RED half, which is the half that protects the user, plus the surface removals.

SETTLE. Same instrument as the re-aimed f_i row and for the same reason: renderFieldState() writes #relay-ca-path.placeholder at the very END of refreshServerState(), and index.html no longer carries a static placeholder attribute, so an empty-to-populated transition genuinely marks the async refresh as complete. The pane className flips SYNCHRONOUSLY and waiting on it alone races.

Y6 arm 1 - THE SAVE BUTTON IS ABSENT. Its whole job was to persist an UNTESTED configuration, which is exactly what the invariant forbids. find_count is the surface half; server_pane.rs carries the negative source pin so it stays gone.
Y6 arm 2 - THE HELPER SENTENCES ARE ABSENT. Both per-field status lines are gone from the DOM entirely, not merely blanked.
Y6 arm 3 - THE x CONTROLS ARE PRESENT BUT HIDDEN WHILE NOTHING IS STORED. Visible-only-when-stored is the ruled behaviour; on a fresh profile neither secret exists, so both carry the hidden class.

RUNG 1 - THE NETWORK RUNG, DRIVEN FIRST AND DELIBERATELY BEFORE ANY CA PATH IS TYPED. Ordering matters here for a measured reason: the CA field cannot be cleared once filled (WebDriver sendkeys refuses an empty string) and switching panes does NOT reset the form - selectPane only toggles the hidden class (main.js:720-725), it never re-runs refreshServerPane. So the two rungs are driven in the order that needs no clearing at all. With no CA supplied the probe passes the certificate rung entirely and fails on the network, which is the ordinary failure a user meets.

Y1 arm, SURFACE HALF - THE FAILED TEST SAVED NOTHING, and the pane SAYS SO. ⚠ THE ASSERTION IS endsWith, NOT EQUALITY, and that is the correct shape rather than a loosening: the ruled sentence is APPENDED to whatever rung-specific diagnosis precedes it, so each rung reads as its own explanation followed by the same guarantee. An equality match would hold on no rung at all - measured, this row first failed asserting equality against a rung's full sentence, which CONTAINS the ruled text.

steps.script: return document.getElementById('relay-detail').textContent.trim().endsWith('Nothing saved — your previous settings are unchanged.');

steps.text: Y1 arm, DISK HALF - settings.json never gained the address. NOTE THE INSTRUMENT AND ITS BOUNDARY: the runner has no file-hash op, so this is a PER-KEY claim, not a byte-identity one. It is nevertheless complete for this file, because settings.json's key set is exactly three and is pinned by the settings_key_allowlist unit test plus serde deny_unknown_fields - a fourth key cannot appear without failing an existing test. relay_url is OMITTED entirely while empty (skip_serializing_if), so the absent-key read below is the correct assertion for 'never written'.

RUNG 2 - THE CA RUNG, plus Y6 arm 4 (the ~ expansion is VISIBLE in the field BEFORE the path is used). ⚠ OPEN THE DISCLOSURE FIRST: #relay-ca-path lives inside <details class="tech" id="relay-ca">, which ships COLLAPSED, and WebDriver sendkeys requires an interactable element - typing into it while shut silently leaves the field EMPTY (measured; the first run of this scenario failed exactly there). No prior scenario had ever reached inside a <details>. Clicking the summary is also the real user path.

Y5 arm - THE CA PATH THAT DOES NOT EXIST IS NAMED, NOT CONGRATULATED. Before this lane relay_ca_file_set stored ANY non-empty string without touching the filesystem - it never validated, and the doc comment claiming it did was false (ENG-0222) - so a garbage path was accepted and then reported as configured. Now the probe's own CA rung runs BEFORE any socket is opened and returns the specific code, which the pane renders beside the field the user must fix. The remaining three CA arms (unreadable, not-a-certificate, and a REAL PEM accepted) are driven in na0754_persist_boundary.rs, where a fixture file can be written.

steps.script: return document.getElementById('relay-detail').textContent.trim().endsWith('Nothing saved — your previous settings are unchanged.');
